summary: Iter-23 — verified the new Flux + Kling 2.1 standard image-to-video (i2v) integration plus the cheap `flux_static` opt-out path. Backend 10/10 pytest PASS covering: estimator costs for flux (~60c/2 scenes), flux_static (~10c/2 scenes), kling t2v (~102c/2 scenes), veo3 sanity; constant `KLING_I2V_COST_CENTS_5S = 25` and model id `fal-ai/kling-video/v2.1/standard/image-to-video` present; render queue submission for both flux and flux_static does NOT crash and ai_engine persists on the render doc; AND the db.kling_i2v_cache write path verified by stubbing `_fal_kling_i2v_generate` (with cleanup) + cache-hit short-circuit verified. Frontend 9/9 Playwright checks PASS: AIEnginePicker shows all 5 options including ai-engine-flux & ai-engine-flux_static; chip label flips between 'Engine · Flux + Kling i2v' and 'Engine · Flux Static'; storyboard subtitles render 'AI still + i2v motion' (flux), 'AI still' (flux_static), 'AI video · kling' (kling), 'AI video · veo3' (veo3). No real Kling spend incurred.

action_items: (Optional) Add a backend index on db.kling_i2v_cache._id is implicit; consider a TTL index (e.g. cached_at + 30 days) so stale Kling URLs (some FAL output URLs do expire) get re-generated rather than serving 404s indefinitely.
(Optional) The fallback chain when Kling fails (-> ken-burns) is logged at WARNING; consider bumping to a metric/counter (e.g. db.kling_i2v_failures) so admin telemetry catches systemic outages.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py L1145-1148 — KLING_I2V_MODEL, COST_CENTS_5S/10S, and MAX_WAIT_S are all top-level constants. Clean separation from T2V cost dict. Good.

server.py L1221-1265 _make_i2v_clip — cache key uses sha256 truncated to 32 chars; collision risk negligible (~2^128). Cache writes raw_url + image_url + aspect + duration_bucket + cached_at. Trim is delegated to _trim_t2v_clip which means the cache is keyed on the un-trimmed Kling output and trimming is done per-call — correct since per-scene durations vary by ms but Kling only outputs 5s/10s buckets.

server.py L1166 — Kling duration rounding: `duration_s_str = '10' if (duration_ms / 1000.0) > 5.5 else '5'`. Same logic in _make_i2v_clip for duration_bucket. They must stay in sync or cache hits will be misaligned. Currently in sync but worth a comment or shared helper.
server.py L2169-2180 normalize_scene — clean fallback chain: flux_static -> ken-burns; flux -> i2v then if mp4 is None -> ken-burns. Single i2v failure won't kill the render. Good.
server.py L1586-1588 estimator — clean conditional on engine string; flux_static skips the i2v cost addition. Matches actual_cost accumulation at L2062-2063 (parity between estimate and actual).

Pickers.jsx L614-678 — Engine options array has correct testids `ai-engine-flux`, `ai-engine-flux_static`, `ai-engine-kling`, `ai-engine-veo3`, `ai-engine-pika`. Admin-only adminCost display preserved.
Studio.jsx L692-705 — chip label map covers all 5 engines with a sensible fallback to 'AI Engine'.

Studio.jsx L1019-1026 — storyboard subtitle correctly branches: flux_static -> 'AI still', flux -> 'AI still + i2v motion', else -> `AI video · ${aiEngine}`. CSS text-transform renders these uppercase but the underlying text matches the spec.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 render docs in `renders` collection during queue-submission tests (status progressed past queued — will fail later when real TTS/FAL is exercised, but never crashed). Cache write tests created and CLEANED UP 1 db.kling_i2v_cache entry each. Net cache delta = 0.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kling i2v integration ships clean: estimator + cache + render-queue + frontend chip/labels all verified. For future tests of an actual end-to-end Kling render (NOT recommended unless you want to spend $0.25/scene): set ai_engine='flux' on a /api/studio/render call with a tiny script and monitor db.kling_i2v_cache for the new entry — the cache key is `kling_i2v:` + sha256('<flux_url>|9_16|5').hexdigest()[:32]. The fallback chain (Kling fail -> ken-burns) is exercised by patching _fal_kling_i2v_generate to return None. To run all backend tests against the live preview: `python -m pytest /app/backend/tests/test_kling_i2v_v23.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_23_kling_i2v.xml`.
rca of the issue: No bug — this iteration verified a new feature. Two minor learnings: (1) the storyboard subtitle DOM class is `.storyboard-thumb-engine` (not `.scene-thumb`) so playwright tests should select on the real class; corrected mid-run. (2) Render `status` field has many intermediate values (queued/voiceover/visuals/normalize/...); tests should assert the field exists and `ai_engine` persists, not enumerate every status string.
